title: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2018

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO
PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO. 2 OF 2018
SUPREME COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2018
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
9th October, 2018]
No.
F.2(2)/2018-Pub., dated 8.10.2018.---The
following President's Order promulgated by the President is hereby published
for general information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.2 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
Now,
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to
make the following Order:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Order may be called the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges)
(Amendment) Order, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2018
sections.description:
Amendment of paragraph 25, P.O.2 of 1997

PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO
PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO. 2 OF 2018
SUPREME COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2018
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
9th October, 2018]
No.
F.2(2)/2018-Pub., dated 8.10.2018.---The
following President's Order promulgated by the President is hereby published
for general information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.2 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
Now,
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to
make the following Order:-
2. Amendment
of paragraph 25, P.O.2 of 1997.---In
the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order 1997 (P.O. 2 of
1997), in paragraph 25, in sub-paragraph (1), for clause (a), the following
shall be substituted, namely:-
"(a)
the services of a driver and an orderly or to draw a Special Additional Pension
equal to the pay and allowances of a contingent driver and an orderly as
admissible from time to time to the employees of same scale of the Supreme
Court of Pakistan:
Provided
that the Chief Justice shall also be entitled to the services of an Assistant
Private Secretary (BS-16):
Provided
further that his widow shall not be entitled to the facility of Assistant
Private Secretary;".
